tests.name: destroy_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify destruction of an empty array via public JSON parse and scope exit.

tests.name: destroy_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify destruction of an empty object via public JSON parse and scope exit.

tests.name: destroy_nested_containers
tests.intent: Verify destruction of a moderately nested array and object structure.

tests.name: parse_and_destroy_large_flat_array
tests.intent: Verify destruction of a large flat array parsed from a string.

tests.name: deeply_nested_containers_walk
tests.intent: Verify destruction of containers nested beyond recursion limit to exercise destroy_walk.

tests.name: stream_extraction_destruction
tests.intent: Verify container destruction after extraction from a stringstream.

tests.name: stream_insertion_serialization
tests.intent: Verify container operations through stream insertion and destruction.

tests.name: to_string_and_destroy
tests.intent: Verify string conversion and subsequent cleanup of complex json objects.

tests.name: ordered_json_container_destruction
tests.intent: Verify destruction path for ordered_json containers.

tests.name: comparison_scalar_operators
tests.intent: Verify comparison operators that reach json_value handling.

tests.name: format_as_custom_type
tests.intent: Verify format_as integration which reaches basic_json handling.

tests.name: clear_and_destroy_container
tests.intent: Verify clearing containers explicitly followed by destruction.

tests.name: push_back_pop_back_destruction
tests.intent: Verify dynamic modification and destruction of container elements.

tests.name: object_erase_destruction
tests.intent: Verify erasure of object members and their immediate destruction.

tests.name: assignment_destroys_old_value
tests.intent: Verify that assigning a new value properly destroys the old container value.

tests.name: move_constructor_container
tests.intent: Verify move construction of container values.

tests.name: move_assignment_container
tests.intent: Verify move assignment of container values and destruction of target.

tests.name: json_pointer_destruction
tests.intent: Verify destruction of values accessed and manipulated via json_pointer.

tests.name: merge_patch_destruction
tests.intent: Verify application of merge_patch and cleanup of replaced containers.

tests.name: json_patch_destruction
tests.intent: Verify application of RFC 6902 json patch and associated container memory management.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise destroy_walk and walk_child with deeply nested objects (rather than arrays) to execute walk_child for object type, hitting the JSON_ASSERT(v.m_type == value_t::object) line.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise pop_walk_child with deeply nested objects to hit the object path containing JSON_ASSERT(v.m_type == value_t::object) and object::erase inside destroy_walk.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Directly instantiate and reference basic_json::data via JSON_PRIVATE_UNLESS_TESTED to explicitly instantiate and touch basic_json::data.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Combine deep nesting of alternating objects and arrays to ensure both object and array walk_child and pop_walk_child branches are robustly tested in destroy_walk.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise destroy_walk with large object structures nested past recursion limit, ensuring element erasure and iterator traversal on object types are fully exercised.

tests.intent: Verify container destruction after extraction from a stringstream.

tests.name: push_back_pop_back_destruction_fixed
tests.intent: Verify dynamic modification and destruction of container elements.
